name: Inventors
overview: Scripture reveals that God is the ultimate Creator, having made the heavens and the earth from the beginning. Jesus Christ affirms that He alone is the way to the Father, embodying truth and life. In contrast, human inventiveness apart from God can lead to the creation of evil, as Romans identifies those who are 'inventors of evil things' among those disobedient and opposed to God. Thus, while invention reflects creativity, the Bible warns against using it for sinful purposes rather than honoring God as the source of all true wisdom and life.
